models.title: Receivables turnover from credit sales
models.summary: The liquidity exhibit divides credit sales by average receivables.

relationship.original_equation: Accounts receivable turnover = credit sales / average receivables
relationship.translation_notes: The turnover is a dimensionless count for the stated financial period.

variables.definition: Sales on credit net of relevant returns and allowances for the reporting period
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

variables.definition: Average trade accounts receivable over the same period
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

variables.definition: Net credit sales divided by average receivables
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Credit sales and average receivables cover the same entity, currency and financial period.
The receivable population matches the credit sales included in the numerator.
limitations: Total revenue is a possible proxy when credit sales are unavailable, but is a different numerator and is separately modeled.
Receivables averaging conventions can materially affect the ratio.
